Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the original blue mug from the source visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
node.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED, tracking the source light-blue mug by its appearance, location, and visual context. Fulfillment requires the source mug itself to be visibly positioned to the right of the headphones; a different or newly appearing mug on the right does not establish this. For incomplete progress, credit concrete visual evidence that the source mug was displaced toward the headphones’ right side, even if its identity is not fully resolved, only when the source-location remnant and the nearby mug’s placement jointly support an apparent movement attempt. Consider whether the remnant’s location and the nearby mug’s placement support that interpretation; proximity alone, a residual blur alone, or a separate mug-like object alone is insufficient. Do not infer movement merely from the source mug being absent or from an unrelated mug appearing elsewhere. If the images do not resolve whether there is evidence of an apparent displacement, treat the evidence as insufficient.
node.binding: SOURCE: the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones. EDITED: a blue blurred remnant appears at the former left-side location, a small white mug is immediately left of/overlapping the headphones, and another white mug is farther right. Neither white mug is visibly identifiable as the source blue mug. The remnant and nearby mug jointly may support an apparent incomplete displacement toward the headphones, but proximity alone does not prove continuity; the far-right white mug alone does not establish that the source mug is now to the right.
node.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
node.aspect: Relative position and continuity of the source mug and headphones
node.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
node.necessity: Moving the requested source mug, rather than introducing or repositioning a different mug, is necessary to fulfill the requested relative placement.
node.zero_when: There is no concrete visual evidence of requested displacement of the source blue mug toward the headphones’ right side; absence at its source location, a residual blur alone, or a different mug on the right does not count.
node.half_when: The source-location remnant and a nearby mug’s placement jointly provide concrete visual evidence consistent with an incomplete displacement of the source blue mug toward the headphones’ right side, but the source mug is not visibly established as positioned to their right. Proximity alone or an ambiguous remnant without supporting placement evidence is insufficient.
node.full_when: The source blue mug is visibly identifiable as the same mug and is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image; a different white mug on the right or ambiguous blur is not sufficient.

node_traces.evidence: The edited image shows a blue blurred remnant at the source mug’s former left-side location and a small white mug immediately left of/overlapping the headphones. Together these provide concrete evidence consistent with an attempted displacement toward the headphones, but the nearby mug is not visibly identifiable as the original blue mug and is not to the headphones’ right. The separate white mug farther right does not establish that it is the source mug. Thus there is partial apparent movement evidence, but the requested endpoint is not achieved.
